notes.title: Patch 1.4.1 with Minor Changes
notes.notes:
This patch includes:

- Better UI colors for buttons.
- Better positions for the buildings in Build/Produce Zones.
- Fixed controller labels for Steam Deck/PS5/XBox/etc
- Enhanced controller mapping help in options menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0. The Simplified Chinese Support Is Live!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that the patch 1.4.0 is now live on Steam! It includes full Simplified Chinese Support with all of the achievements, texts and voiceovers for more than 400 dialogues!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/a185f0ccbeb550d1030621490f28c50a7cde9fff.png[/img]

Update now :) Even if you don't know Chinese it is so fun to play the game and listen to the language!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/ad1b14382f395c5163a184982c73fe74d322d90e.png[/img]

notes.title: Big Update 1.3.8!
notes.notes:
We just uploaded the patch 1.3.8! It includes 32 achivements that you can finally unlock!

Achievements include classic "cut 100 trees", find cross-references between games and true achievemnets for those who like to discover all corners of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/c580490aea64949dde6b90ce19cc7d75f70e305e.png[/img]

[h1]Sound and Music Volume Controls[/h1]
You can change the music and sounds volume so that you can stream it more comfortably or play with your own music in the background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/527ff7bbd7c6b148f6c7ec2cfb5378a6afb45a6c.png[/img]

[h1]Camera Zoom[/h1]

Use your mouse wheel to zoom in/out the main camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/c7261aca0a6416f542f34420225518b3cec7eb8f.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, players![/b]

We received enormous feedback and the #1 point was to [b]add Achievements to the Steam[/b]! And have prepared them for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/675c19042b33df620562017e6d0a13f9ab1743d4.png[/img]
Now we are in stage of creating the art for achievements. The achievements will differ from 'number grinding' (lots of folks asked for them) to really adventerous achievements for those, who like to discover all corners of the games!

[u]We plan to publish them soon on Steam, next week[/u] 👌

Thank you for the support, Dmytro&Svitlana 💛

notes.title: Steam Cloud Save Support
notes.notes:
We have enabled [b]Steam Cloud Save support![/b] Now you can play on different devices and share the same progress between your PC/SteamDecks!

All works without any updates.

[u][b]Next: Steam Achievements. Soon. [/b][/u]

Thank you for the tremendous support! We did not expect to get so many sales on Steam!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731452/bfbf7112af45d202b931fca8ae0c7b9aec27316c.jpg[/img]
